research_objectives: Assess the current market size and growth trajectory of the AI industry in India.
Identify key sectors where AI adoption is driving significant economic value.
Evaluate the regulatory environment and government policy support for AI startups and enterprises.
Analyze competitive dynamics and the role of domestic versus global tech players.
Identify critical infrastructure challenges and human capital requirements for scaling AI in India.
